summary: Gray Media, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a $750 million offering of senior secured first lien notes due 2034, exempt under Rule 144A/Regulation S. Proceeds will redeem $675 million of its outstanding 10.500% senior secured first lien notes due 2029 at 105.250% of principal plus accrued interest, repay revolving credit borrowings, and pay fees. The redemption is conditioned on the offering's completion. This is a routine debt refinancing transaction, not a special situation deal; no equity securities, M&A, or strategic event is involved.
